description:
*“I have never belonged anywhere in my life,
and if it meant I could survive, I wanted to become anything at all.”*

Saepalgam, born between a magpie spirit and a human.  
Eun Seongmok, raised in contempt by his own clan.

With nowhere to rely on, the two become entangled through a chance connection and come to be each other’s one and only.

A pure yet resilient love story, like plum blossoms in bloom.


**Original Webtoon:**  
[BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230107), [Bomtoon](https://bomtoon.com/detail/aoghkeus), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/maehwadyeon), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10998816), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/120074245), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000062776)
